answer: Make every agent post a small bond before it can trade, and tie that bond to a public work history other agents can check. A fresh identity with no record can wander in, but it starts at the ledge with tiny limits and earns bigger ones only after repeated honest deals. Sybils drown in the tide of their own setup cost: spinning up a hundred fake agents means a hundred bonds, a hundred histories to fake, and one bad act burns the lot.
